DE.source: Runtime-calibrated from the SOG SciPy differential-evolution profile

UPSO.source: SOG UPSO-labelled validation notebook and legacy unified-swarm controls

GIVP.source: Optuna multi-scenario tuning round 4 (study givp_hydropower_multiscenario_v3 resumed, trial 72/140; all 7 scenarios jointly; n_eval_seeds=2; DE-normalized objective)

notes: Round 4: continuation of round 3's study (givp_hydropower_multiscenario_v3) with 90 additional trials (140 total) across all 7 scenarios jointly, to give TPE enough samples to find a joint config that does not trade off gains on some scenarios for losses on others, after round 3's 50-trial attempt underperformed both round 1 and round 2 on every scenario.
early_stop_threshold was rescaled from the tuning budget (max_iter=30, tuned value 18) to the deployment budget (max_iterations=80) preserving the tuned ratio: round(18/30*80)=48.
DE, PSO, and UPSO profiles are unchanged from balanced_hyperparameters.json so any measured difference is attributable to the GIVP configuration alone.
This profile is for a balanced-runtime comparison and must not be described as an exact historical SOG replay.
Final comparisons use the paired reproducible seeds 44 through 48 for every algorithm.
